sentences.japanese: 靴をブラシで磨く必要がある。泥で汚れているから。
sentences.english: Your shoes need brushing. They are muddy.

sentences.japanese: 靴から泥を取り除いてください。
sentences.english: Please remove the mud from your shoes.

sentences.japanese: 家にあがる前に靴を脱げば靴の泥を家の中に持ち込まずにすむ。
sentences.english: If you take your shoes off before coming into the house you won't bring in any dirt from your shoes.

sentences.japanese: その知らせは彼の誠実さに泥を塗る事になろう。
sentences.english: That news will besmirch his reputation for honesty.

sentences.japanese: そのこそ泥は窓をこじ開けている現場を捕まった。
sentences.english: The burglar was caught in the act of prying open the window.
